description: Offices and seats people held, from published reference works, by Civgraph person id: government and party offices, judicial and civic posts, and seats in bodies Civgraph has no election data for (Seanad Éireann, the Senate of Northern Ireland, the pre-1801 Irish House of Commons, constituencies outside Ireland). Seats Civgraph's own election results already show are left out, and the Browse pages drop a Commons seat here when the person has a History of Parliament biography. Facts only, each cited to the work and page; no text from the works is held here. A year the work gives that other sources contradict is left out rather than repeated.
